description: This line plot illustrates the relationship between BLEU score and Average Lagging (AL) for four different training methods in simultaneous machine translation. The x-axis, labeled “Average Lagging (AL),” ranges from 0 to 8 with tick marks at integer intervals, representing the degree of latency in translation. The y-axis, labeled “BLEU,” spans from 20 to 30 with major gridlines every 2 units, indicating translation quality. Four distinct lines are plotted: “Consistency-CE” (light purple circles, dashed line) starts at approximately BLEU 20.2 at AL=1 and rises steadily to about 29.5 at AL=8; “Inconsistency-CE” (dark purple squares, dash-dot line) begins at BLEU 22.3 at AL=1 and increases to roughly 29.8 at AL=8; “Inconsistency-CE-MP” (blue squares, dashed line) starts at BLEU 22.2 at AL=1 and climbs to about 29.5 at AL=8; and “Consistency-Bi” (red stars, solid line) begins at BLEU 24.8 at AL=1 and reaches approximately 30.2 at AL=8. All methods show a positive correlation between AL and BLEU, with “Consistency-Bi” consistently achieving the highest BLEU scores across all AL values.
